```{r clean}
library(lubridate)

# keep only minimal data needed
# same column names
precip_bare <- precip |> 
    dplyr::mutate(CollectionDate = lubridate::date(DateTime)) |> 
    dplyr::select(CollectionDate, NO3_Final, NH4ugNL_Final)

stream_bare <- stream |>
  dplyr::rename(NH4ugNL_Final = NH4ugNL) |> #assumed
  dplyr::mutate(CollectionDate = lubridate::mdy(CollectionDate)) |>
  dplyr::select(CollectionDate, NO3_Final, NH4ugNL_Final)
dplyr::glimpse(stream_bare) # check character-to-date is correct

discharge_bare <- discharge |>
  dplyr::select(datetime, Q_mm_day) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CollectionDate = lubridate::date(datetime))
dplyr::glimpse(discharge_bare) # check character-to-date is correct
```

```{r bin_dates}
# same time resolutions
# NAs ignored within a day
# saved in case want to fork/build on this step later

precip_bare_binned_daily <- precip_bare |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    precip_NO3_Final_binned_daily = mean(NO3_Final, na.rm = TRUE), # NAs ignored within a day
    precip_NH4ugNL_Final_binned_daily = mean(NH4ugNL_Final, na.rm = TRUE), # NAs ignored within a day
    .by = 'CollectionDate'
  )
length(discharge_bare_binned_daily$CollectionDate) #check n rows 
# write.csv(precip_bare_binned_daily, here::here('Pairing_HBR/data_binned/precip_bare_binned_daily.csv'))

stream_bare_binned_daily <- stream_bare |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    stream_NO3_Final_binned_daily = mean(NO3_Final, na.rm = TRUE),
    stream_NH4ugNL_Final_binned_daily = mean(NH4ugNL_Final, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = 'CollectionDate'
  )
length(stream_bare_binned_daily$CollectionDate) #check n rows is the same
# write.csv(stream_bare_binned_daily, here::here('Pairing_HBR/data_binned/stream_bare_binned_daily.csv'))

discharge_bare_binned_daily <- stream_bare |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    discharge_NO3_Final_binned_daily = mean(NO3_Final, na.rm = TRUE),
    discharge_NH4ugNL_Final_binned_daily = mean(NH4ugNL_Final, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = 'CollectionDate'
  )
length(discharge_bare_binned_daily$CollectionDate) #check n rows is the same
# write.csv(discharge_bare_binned_daily, here::here('Pairing_HBR/data_binned/discharge_bare_binned_daily.csv'))
```


```{r pair_shared_dates}
HBR_paired_data <- dplyr::inner_join(
  precip_bare_binned_daily,
  stream_bare_binned_daily,
  by = 'CollectionDate'
) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(discharge_bare_binned_daily, by = 'CollectionDate')
# write.csv(HBR_paired_data, here::here('Pairing_HBR/HBR_paired_data.csv'))
```
